title: 1V1+2 Targets
setup: 15X15 or larger area, two teams of 3 players per square.
instructions: Pass to targets on each side and receive the ball back.
Player in possesion scores when passing to one side then passing to the other side and receiving the ball back.
2 points wins, and switch the two players in the middle.
THE DEFENDER MUST GO AFTER THE BALL to put pressure on the outside target players (defenders can go outside the square).
But target players are not allowed inside the square.
coachingPoints: Pop away to get open (early, good angle and distance of support).
ESCAPE THE PRESSURE by dribbling side to side, and shield if necessary.
